svg.title: Human male head frame reference — hair male1
svg.desc: Original Starbound human male pixels. 29 named target cells, 29 unique frame IDs. Embedded PNGs are reference artwork, not an importable template. Each named cell uses its own source frame; aliases refer to the same target cell. Unused cells contain no image. Game artwork remains property of its original rights holders.
svg.metadata: Source package: /home/fleurs/Code/OpenStarbound/assets/packed.pak. Source image: /humanoid/human/emote.png (387x344). Frame document: /humanoid/emote.frames. Target: core character_layout(head) 387x344, 43x43 top-down cells. Head composition: /humanoid/human/malehead.png:normal at (43, 0) plus human emote at its named frame, straight-alpha source-over. Each named target uses its own canonical source frame. Frame IDs: sad.3 is 28, oooh.1 is 29; existing IDs 1 through 27 are unchanged.
svg.text: Human male / hair male1 — head reference
Target PNG 387 x 344; cells 43 x 43; 29 named cells / 29 IDs. Coordinates are top-down PNG pixels.
Complete heads: malehead.png:normal + each human emote (alpha-over), without hair.
Each named head cell has an independent ID and uses its corresponding canonical human emote frame.
Aliases (= names) use their named cell. Empty grid cells are unused; do not paint them.
REFERENCE ONLY — not a PNG import template. Game pixels: original rights holders; no art relicensing.
